01 · Executive summary

A mobile product for a fibre brand, with no network to build

ipNX customers are among the most travelled people in Nigeria. Every time they fly, their data spend leaks to roaming bills, airport SIM kiosks and dollar-priced eSIM apps. An ipNX travel eSIM, sold on ipnxnigeria.net, in the self-care portal and through enterprise account managers, brings that spend onto the ipNX relationship, with no spectrum, no stock and no platform to build.

The market

The travel eSIM market exceeds $4.4B by 2030 with around 280M users. Nigeria's affluent, diaspora-connected households and business travellers are exactly the buyers driving it.

The reach

Sold through touch points ipNX already owns: ipnxnigeria.net, the self-care portal, the monthly invoice and renewal emails, and the enterprise account team.

The economics

– uplift per travelling customer, at a 3–7% attach rate within 12 months, on a revenue-share model with near-zero capex.

Live in about 2 weeks White-label, ipNX-owned Revenue-share, no platform to build
02 · The product

What is a Travel eSIM?

eSIM

A tiny, built-in chip in modern phones that can hold several mobile plans digitally, with no plastic SIM to swap.

Travel eSIM

A short-term data plan bought online for the country or region being visited. Scan a QR code or tap a link, the plan downloads, and the traveller is online the moment they land in London, Dubai, Accra or Jeddah.

1
Bought before the trip, on ipnxnigeria.net or in the self-care portal, paid in naira
2
Scan or tap to install over home fibre Wi-Fi, no shop, no plastic SIM, no queue
3
Land connected, Nigerian line stays live for calls, WhatsApp and bank OTPs
03 · Traveller value

Why Nigerian travellers choose a Travel eSIM

Every reason below is a reason to buy. If ipNX does not offer it, the traveller pays for roaming, buys from a dollar-priced global app, or queues at an airport kiosk, and the margin leaves the country with them.

Cheaper than roaming

Local data rates abroad cost far less than home-network roaming bundles.

Paid in naira

No dollar card and no international spend limit to wrestle with. Bought from a Nigerian brand, in naira.

Instant setup

Install at home over ipNX fibre before leaving, and be online the moment the plane lands.

No bill shock

Prepaid data with clear allowances, and usage that is easy to track.

Keep your number

Dual-SIM: travel eSIM for data, Nigerian SIM stays live for calls and bank OTPs.

Flexible

Top up, extend a stay, or cover a multi-country trip with one regional plan.

05 · Strategic fit

Why ipNX should own this line

  • You already hold the trust and the billing relationship. ipNX has served Nigerian homes and businesses since 2002, and it launched the country's first 1Gbps residential fibre. Customers who trust ipNX at home will buy their connectivity abroad from the same brand.
  • A mobile product, without becoming a mobile operator. No spectrum, no towers, no SIM stock. Data is carried on partner networks abroad at wholesale rates.
  • Stop the leakage. Roaming bills and dollar-priced eSIM apps capture spend from ipNX's most valuable customers. This brings it back onto the ipNX account.
  • Stickier fibre. A customer who travels on ipNX and comes home to ipNX has one more reason not to churn to a competitor.
  • Own the data. Every purchase is a first-party travel signal for retention, upgrades and enterprise upsell.

Buy at home on fibre. Land connected.

09 · Commercials

Simple, low-risk commercial terms

Once-off
Project set-up, website and self-care storefront configuration, paid up front. That is the whole build cost.
Ongoing
Rev-share
ipNX takes 50% of net margin (retail, less VAT, data and eSIM cost), which is about 10% of retail on floor-priced bundles. No fixed platform fee.
Speed
~2 weeks
Full integration and go-live from signature: scoping, build, storefront configuration, launch.

How the deal is structured

  • MVNE builds and configures the travel eSIM services on its platforms for ipNX.
  • Bundles priced per destination, with wholesale data carried at partner rates.
  • Monthly revenue-share report, ipNX invoices for its share, settled within 30 days.
  • Pricing indicative in USD, shown in naira at ₦1,332 / $ (CBN official rate, 13 Oct 2026). Proposal valid 30 days, subject to a comprehensive contract and signed SOW.

12 · Roadmap

From signature to live in about two weeks

Step 1 · Scoping

Requirements and journey mapping

Business and technical specs, customer-journey mapping across the website, the self-care portal and the enterprise offer, and the DARE model. Both parties sign off.

Step 2 · ~1 week

Build and configure

MVNE builds the travel eSIM services, configures ipNX-branded bundles in naira, and stands the white-label storefront up on your subdomain.

Step 3

Integrate and simulate

Portal and website hooks wired to the API, PSP connected, first batch of eSIM profiles readied, end-to-end business simulation and UAT.

Step 4 · Go-live

Launch to market

ipNX Travel eSIM live on the website, in the self-care portal and in customer emails, timed for the next travel peak. Start selling.

What ipNX needs to bring

  • Brand assets and sign-off on the customer journey
  • Placement in the self-care portal and on ipnxnigeria.net
  • A subdomain for the storefront and deep links in invoices and emails
  • A launch push to the customer base and an enterprise account-team briefing
  • Signed SOW and commercial contract
No platform to build No team to hire No stock to hold
